name: End to Reminiscence
source: A short story of one man's reminiscence to his youth, when he, despite his inner turmoil, antipathy, and alienation, is given a final chance at genuine love. A romantic story inspired by White Nights.
translation: 这是一个关于一个男人回忆青春的短篇故事，当时他尽管内心动荡、反感和疏远，却获得了获得真爱的最后机会。一个受《白夜》启发的浪漫故事。
